title: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
summary: Traders are pricing in a 78% chance of a December rate hike, while analysts say Treasury yields, the US dollar and upcoming inflation data could determine Bitcoin’s next move.
content: The Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates while maintaining a hawkish stance has increased pressure on Bitcoin. Traders are pricing in a significant chance of a December rate hike. According to analysts, upcoming inflation data, Treasury yields, and the movement of the US dollar will likely dictate Bitcoin's next major price direction in the near term.
content_ta: பெடரல் ரிசர்வ் வட்டி விகிதங்களை மாற்றாமல் வைத்திருப்பதுடன் தனது கடுமையான நிலைப்பாட்டை தொடர்வது Bitcoin மீது அழுத்தத்தை அதிகரித்துள்ளது. டிசம்பர் மாதத்தில் வட்டி விகிதம் உயர்த்தப்பட அதிக வாய்ப்புள்ளதாக வர்த்தகர்கள் கருதுகின்றனர். வரவிருக்கும் பணவீக்க புள்ளிவிவரங்கள், கருவூலக் கடன் ஈவுத்தொகைகள் மற்றும் US dollar-ன் நகர்வுகள் ஆகியவை Bitcoin-ன் அடுத்த கட்ட விலை மாற்றத்தைத் தீர்மானிக்கும் என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் கூறுகின்றனர்.

title: Canton crypto: Cancore announces $7.2M round as CC rebounds toward $0.10
summary: New funding will support Cancore’s blockchain connections and automated trading tools as Canton Coin attempts a modest recovery.
content: Cancore has announced a $7.2 million funding round to support its blockchain connections and automated trading tools. The new capital arrives as Canton Coin experiences a modest price recovery toward the $0.10 mark, reflecting renewed market activity surrounding the Canton crypto ecosystem and its supporting infrastructure development.
content_ta: Cancore நிறுவனம் தனது blockchain இணைப்புகள் மற்றும் automated trading tools-ஐ மேம்படுத்துவதற்காக $7.2 மில்லியன் நிதி திரட்டியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. Canton Coin மதிப்பு $0.10 விலையை நோக்கி சிறிய மீட்சியை சந்தித்து வரும் காலகட்டத்தில் இந்த புதிய நிதி வந்துள்ளது.

title: Raoul Pal Says AI Spending Has No Ceiling. Are Tech Stocks in Danger?
summary:
Raoul Pal says AI capex by hyperscalers has no ceiling and calls Big Tech debt fears overblown, even as bond sales jump sharply in 2026.
The post Raoul Pal Says AI Spending Has No Ceiling. Are Tech Stocks in Danger? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Raoul Pal states that artificial intelligence capital expenditures by major tech companies have no ceiling and dismisses concerns regarding Big Tech debt as overblown. This comes despite a sharp rise in bond sales projected for 2026. While AI infrastructure spending continues to grow aggressively, market observers remain divided on whether these high spending levels pose risks for tech stocks moving forward.
content_ta: Raoul Pal-யின் கூற்றுப்படி, AI துறையில் பெரிய tech நிறுவனங்களின் மூலதனச் செலவினத்திற்கு (capex) எந்த வரம்பும் இல்லை. மேலும், Big Tech நிறுவனங்களின் கடன் குறித்த அச்சங்கள் மிகைப்படுத்தப்பட்டவை என்றும் அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார். 2026-ல் பாண்ட் விற்பனை கணிசமாக அதிகரிக்கும் போதிலும் இந்த நிலைப்பாடு தொடர்கிறது. AI உள்கட்டமைப்புச் செலவுகள் தொடர்ந்து அதிகரித்து வரும் நிலையில், இந்த அதிகப்படியான செலவுகள் tech stocks-களுக்கு ஆபத்தை ஏற்படுத்துமா என்பது குறித்து சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் மத்தியில் விவாதங்கள் நிலவுகின்றன.

title: Oil's War Premium Could Vanish Fast Once a Hormuz Deal Lands, Analysts Warn
summary:
The war premium leaves Brent $20 above JPMorgan's fair value, and BMI expects a steep sell-off after a Hormuz deal.
The post Oil's War Premium Could Vanish Fast Once a Hormuz Deal Lands, Analysts Warn appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Analysts warn that oil prices could experience a sharp sell-off once a deal regarding the Strait of Hormuz is reached. Currently, market experts note that a significant war premium is keeping Brent crude prices well above fair value, leaving the market vulnerable to a rapid price correction if geopolitical tensions ease.
content_ta: Hormuz ஒப்பந்தம் எட்டப்பட்டால், எண்ணெய் விலையில் பெரும் சரிவு ஏற்படக்கூடும் என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் எச்சரித்துள்ளனர். தற்போது நிலவும் போர் பதற்றம் காரணமாக Brent கச்சா எண்ணெய் விலை நியாயமான மதிப்பை விட அதிகமாக உள்ளதுடன், புவிசார் அரசியல் சூழல் அமைதியடைந்தால் விலையில் உடனடி சரிவு ஏற்படும் அபாயம் உள்ளதாக சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றனர்.

title: 33 Wall Street Giants Block Tokenized Stocks, But Apple and Tesla Stay Silent
summary:
JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, and 31 other companies used a new SEC veto to block tokenized stocks on OKX and ICE’s venue.
The post 33 Wall Street Giants Block Tokenized Stocks, But Apple and Tesla Stay Silent appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Thirty-three Wall Street giants, including JPMorgan and Coca-Cola, have utilized a new SEC veto to block tokenized stocks on the OKX and ICE platforms. Meanwhile, major technology companies like Apple and Tesla have remained silent on the matter, declining to join the coalition in taking action against the digital asset offerings.
content_ta: JPMorgan மற்றும் Coca-Cola உள்ளிட்ட 33 Wall Street நிறுவனங்கள், புதிய SEC வீட்டோ அதிகாரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி OKX மற்றும் ICE தளங்களில் tokenized stocks-ஐத் தடுத்துள்ளன. இதற்கிடையில், Apple மற்றும் Tesla போன்ற முக்கிய தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்கள் இந்த விவகாரம் குறித்து மௌனம் காத்து வருகின்றன.

content_ta: குளோபல் ப்ரோக்கரேஜ் சேவைகளில் ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் செட்டில்மென்ட் மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து வசதிகளை இணைப்பதற்காக டிரைவ்வெல்த் (DriveWealth) நிறுவனம் ரிப்பிள் (Ripple) உடன் கூட்டாண்மை சேர்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பின் மூலம் பிளாக்செயின் தொழில்நுட்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி சர்வதேச பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை விரைவாகவும் திறம்படவும் மேற்கொள்ள திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Napier AI Integrates LSEG World-Check On Demand to Support More Timely, Risk-Based Payment Screening
summary:
Napier AI Transaction Screening has successfully completed the technology validation process for its integration with LSEG’s new World-Check On Demand.
This integration enables financial institutions to screen payments against LSEG’s World-Check risk intelligence through an API within minutes of publication by LSEG analysts. Institutions can apply that intelligence within payment-screening workflows configured around their risk appetite, policies and relevant data sources.
World-Check On Demand is LSEG's next-generation API-based delivery of World-Check risk intelligence. It delivers precise, continuously updated real-time risk intelligence – ensuring organisations have instant access to accurate and relevant data across sanctions, politically exposed persons, adverse media, and enforcement actions.
High-volume PEP and adverse media screening can generate significant numbers of false positives. Napier AI Transaction Screening is built for speed, without trading-off precision. It supports the screening of every payment in real time, including against World-Check On Demand risk intelligence. Additionally, organisations can configure screening by payment rail and customer risk type, allowing firms to define which transactions require World-Check On Demand validation.
Greg Watson, CEO of Napier AI, commented: "Payments move in milliseconds. Sanctions and compliance checks should not be the reason they slow down. Sanctions lists are changing faster and more frequently than ever. Our customers rely on us to screen payments quickly and accurately, and that demands real-time data, that can be used effectively within automated and AI-enabled compliance workflows.
By working with LSEG to bring World-Check On Demand into Napier AI NextGen Transaction Screening, we're helping financial institutions meet regulatory requirements for a truly risk-based approach that reduces over-screening, false positives, and risk exposure through accurate, real-time financial crime intelligence.”
World-Check On Demand in Napier AI Transaction Screening introduces the benefits of an enhanced, more granular data structure that supports risk-based screening configurations. This machine-readable format can support automated and AI-driven workflows while field-level source information provides clearer data provenance. This allows organisations to choose to screen only against sources relevant to their risk appetite.
 Priya Nallan, Head of Product, Screening at LSEG Risk Intelligence, comments: “Effective payment screening depends on institutions having timely access to trusted risk intelligence and the ability to apply it in line with their own risk policies.
“By integrating World-Check On Demand with Napier AI Transaction Screening, we are helping customers access newly published intelligence more quickly and use richer, more granular information within their existing screening workflows. This supports more precise, risk-based screening while keeping institutions in control of their compliance decisions.”

title: EquiLend’s 1Source DLT Adds Goldman Sachs
summary:
Equilend, the global financial technology, data and analytics company for the securities finance industry, today announced that Goldman Sachs is utilizing Equilend 1Source, the distributed ledger technology (DLT) platform that increases efficiency, reduces breaks, and eliminates reconciliations in securities finance.
Goldman Sachs joins BNY and National Bank of Canada on 1Source. The two large securities lenders previously announced that they had begun transmitting live transactions onto the 1Source ledger last October.
1Source is transforming global securities finance workflows by establishing a single, golden source of truth for securities lending and financing transactions. The DLT-based platform was developed by Equilend with input and collaboration from a group of leading market participants to improve costs, automation, and overall efficiency in the market. 1Source directly improves users' P&L by eliminating accrual errors, reducing third-party comparison fees, and improving settlement rates.
Additional counterparties are also in the process of adopting Equilend's 1Source, which will benefit all members of the platform as inefficient reconciliation processes and transaction breaks are reduced.
"We are excited to welcome Goldman Sachs, one of the industry's largest borrowers, onto the 1Source platform," said Rich Grossi, CEO of Equilend. "Their involvement will drive greater platform benefit by reducing costs and increasing operational efficiency across the community of participants."
According to third-party estimates, Equilend's 1Source has the potential to save industry participants hundreds of millions of dollars through greater operational efficiency, optimized costs and resources, and improved profitability.

content: Goldman Sachs has joined Equilend’s 1Source platform, a distributed ledger technology designed to improve efficiency and reduce reconciliation errors in global securities finance. By becoming part of the DLT platform alongside other major financial institutions, Goldman Sachs will help drive operational improvements and cost savings across the industry.
content_ta: குளோபல் செக்யூரிட்டீஸ் ஃபைனான்ஸ் துறையில் செயல்திறனை மேம்படுத்தவும், கணக்கீட்டு பிழைகளைக் குறைக்கவும் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்ட விநியோகிக்கப்பட்ட முறையான DLT பிளாட்ஃபார்மான Equilend-ன் 1Source பிளாட்ஃபார்மில் Goldman Sachs இணைந்துள்ளது. பிற முன்னணி நிதி நிறுவனங்களுடன் இணைந்து இந்த DLT பிளாட்ஃபார்மின் ஒரு பகுதியாக மாறுவதன் மூலம், செயல்பாட்டு மேம்பாடுகளையும் செலவுக் மிச்சத்தையும் கொண்டுவர Goldman Sachs உதவும்.

title: iPipeline Introduces Next-Generation Professional Services Model to Drive Technology Adoption ROI
summary:
iPipeline®, a leading global provider of comprehensive and integrated digital solutions for the life insurance and financial services industry, today announces the launch of iPipeline Services CORE Methodology and its Client Value Group to bring customers a new consultative paradigm for professional services, defined by faster time-to-value, transparent timelines and costs, tailored solutions that meet specific business needs, and ongoing optimization through continuous support models. Together, the initiatives transform iPipeline’s professional services model to help customers implement technology more efficiently, increase adoption, and realize measurable business value faster.
iPipeline Services CORE Methodology addresses an important industry need for professional services to simplify complex technology transformations and deliver continuous value through a consultative approach built around four guiding principles: Client, Outcomes, Rapid, and Execution. The framework starts with understanding each client’s business goals and definition of success, measures performance by business impact rather than activity, accelerates delivery through standardized models, AI-enabled processes and proven best practices, and brings disciplined, consultative execution to every engagement. Instead of focusing solely on one-time implementations, iPipeline’s advisors will deliver ongoing AI-augmented optimization and highly transparent, personalized client engagement. AI-enabled delivery models that accelerate timelines and improve consistency underpin an outcome-driven approach to help agents, carriers, financial institutions, and wealth managers realize return-on-investment faster.
The expanded Professional Services offering includes Consulting, Implementation Packages, Quality-as-a-Service (QaaS), Managed Services, and Training-as-a-Service (TaaS), creating a connected set of services designed to support clients throughout the professional services lifecycle. iPipeline’s new QaaS capabilities use automated testing to improve quality and reduce deployment timelines, while TaaS  provides flexible, on-demand education that enables clients to scale adoption across their organizations.
Mike James, EVP, Professional Services at iPipeline, commented on the new offering, “The landscape of technological innovation is changing as more insurers modernize their operations with operational and AI solutions. Our long-standing relationships with life insurance and annuities providers at every point of the financial and insurance ecosystem give us a ground-level view into their most pressing needs as they work to help everyday people with financial planning and security. Through our CORE Methodology and Client Value Group, we are responding to a growing need for more consultative services tailored to each company’s unique business requirements.”
iPipeline’s new Client Value Group complements the CORE Methodology team in elevating the traditional service provider role into that of a collaborative partner, helping clients identify where value exists within their business and determine how best to unlock it. As an expansion of iPipeline’s business development department, the Client Value Group will provide expert advisory services that align technology and workflows and apply targeted services to improve speed, efficiency, and growth outcomes.
Through a structured Value Levers framework, the Client Value Group will help clients identify and prioritize opportunities for impact, connect relevant implementation, consulting and optimization services, and provide continuous guidance as their business needs change. While CORE defines how iPipeline delivers services, the Client Value Group provides the expert guidance and insight needed to help clients make confident decisions and maintain progress over time.
Together, iPipeline’s Services CORE Methodology team and Client Value Group will act as clients’ digital transformation advocates, providing guidance on where to drive impact and measuring success through business impact and outcomes rather than project completion. Predictable pricing and scalable offerings, including packaged and managed services, give users  greater control and confidence while helping improve delivery predictability and reduce implementation risk. Through end-to-end implementation, advisory, and optimization services, iPipeline will help clients achieve better business outcomes, including accelerated time-to-value, greater adoption, operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and ROI from their life insurance and annuities solutions.
“The decision to adopt and integrate new insurance technology can be a complex, high-stakes endeavor,” said Pat O’Donnell, Chief Executive Officer at iPipeline. “As operational, AI, and data solutions become more sophisticated, it is no longer enough for a solution provider to install, instruct, and go home. This evolution brings together seasoned solution providers who understand the industry, proven delivery models, and advanced technology to ensure solutions are implemented efficiently, adopted effectively, and are continuously improved over time.”
The announcement comes on the heels of iPipeline’s recent integration of iGO Evolve®, iPipeline’s AI-optimized life insurance e-application solution, as the first module on the new Novera AI-First Digital Platform for Life, Annuities and Wealth Powered by CHARLi™, the AI foundation connecting the iPipeline ecosystem. The platform underscores iPipeline’s broader commitment to combining advanced technology with consultative services that accelerate adoption and maximize long-term client value.

content: iPipeline has introduced its new Services CORE Methodology and Client Value Group to help life insurance and financial services clients improve technology adoption and accelerate return on investment. The updated professional services model features AI-enabled delivery, transparent pricing, and ongoing optimization support. Designed to simplify complex digital transformations, the expanded offerings aim to enhance operational efficiency and deliver measurable business value more quickly.
content_ta: life insurance மற்றும் financial services நிறுவனங்கள் தொழில்நுட்பத்தை எளிதாகப் பயன்படுத்தவும், ROI-ஐ விரைவுபடுத்தவும் உதவும் வகையில் iPipeline நிறுவனம் அதன் புதிய Services CORE Methodology மற்றும் Client Value Group-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த மேம்படுத்தப்பட்ட professional services மாதிரி, AI-இயக்கப்பட்ட சேவைகளையும், வெளிப்படையான விலை நிர்ணயத்தையும் கொண்டுள்ளது. சிக்கலான டிஜிட்டல் மாற்றங்களை எளிதாக்கும் வகையில் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ள இந்த விரிவான சேவைகள், செயல்பாட்டுத் திறனை மேம்படுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளன.

title: Former Swift CEO joins stablecoin firm OpenTrade as chairman
summary: Lazaro Campos takes the board role as the London-based company reports $300 million in assets locked and more than $1 billion in annual transaction volume.
content: Lazaro Campos, the former CEO of Swift, has joined London-based stablecoin firm OpenTrade as its new chairman. The appointment comes as the company reports significant milestones, including $300 million in assets locked and over $1 billion in annual transaction volume, highlighting its growing presence in the digital asset and financial technology sector.
content_ta: Swift-ன் முன்னாள் CEO ஆன Lazaro Campos, லண்டனை தளமாகக் கொண்ட stablecoin நிறுவனமான OpenTrade-ல் புதிய தலைவராக (chairman) இணைந்துள்ளார். இந்நிறுவனம் 300 மில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்பிலான முடக்கப்பட்ட சொத்துக்களையும் (assets locked), 1 பில்லியன் டாலருக்கும் அதிகமான வருடாந்திர பரிவர்த்தனை அளவையும் பதிவு செய்துள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ள நிலையில் இந்த நியமனம் வந்துள்ளது.

title: Uniswap Adds 13,137 New Addresses in Its Biggest Growth Spike Since 2020
summary: Uniswap's latest address surge is its largest since 2020, but UNI still needs to defend $7 to keep recovery hopes alive.
content: Uniswap has recorded 13,137 new addresses in its largest growth spike since 2020. Despite this massive surge in network activity, the UNI token still needs to successfully defend the $7 price level in order to keep its current market recovery hopes alive.
content_ta: Uniswap-ல் 2020-க்குப் பிறகு மிகப்பெரிய வளர்ச்சி எழுச்சியாக 13,137 புதிய அட்ரஸ்கள் சேர்க்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. நெட்வொர்க் செயல்பாட்டில் இந்த பெரிய எழுச்சி ஏற்பட்ட போதிலும், UNI தனது தற்போதைய சந்தை மீட்சி நம்பிக்கையைத் தக்கவைக்க $7 விலையை வெற்றிகரமாகப் பாதுகாக்க வேண்டியுள்ளது.

title: House Democrats demand Trump preserve records of AI chatbot conversations
summary:
The demand highlights growing concerns over AI's role in governance, pushing for stricter oversight and transparency in digital communications.
The post House Democrats demand Trump preserve records of AI chatbot conversations appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: House Democrats are calling on Donald Trump to ensure that all records of AI chatbot conversations are properly preserved. This demand underscores rising concerns regarding the transparency and governance of digital communications involving artificial intelligence tools in public office.
content_ta: AI chatbot உரையாடல்களின் அனைத்து பதிவுகளையும் முறையாகப் பாதுகாக்க வேண்டும் என்று Donald Trump-யிடம் House Democrats கோரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளனர். இந்த கோரிக்கையானது, பொது அலுவலகங்களில் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு கருவிகளைப் பயன்படுத்துவது தொடர்பான வெளிப்படைத்தன்மை குறித்த வளர்ந்து வரும் கவலைகளை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: Cathie Wood’s ARK buys the dip on Robinhood in its largest purchase in 6 months after 23% slump
summary: HOOD fell 3.3% on Wednesday, broadening its one-month decline to more than 23%.
content: Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest made its largest purchase of Robinhood shares in six months, capitalizing on a recent 23% slump in the stock. The move comes as Robinhood shares continue to face downward pressure, falling further during recent trading sessions.
content_ta: Cathie Wood-ன் ARK நிறுவனம் கடந்த ஆறு மாதங்களில் இல்லாத அளவுக்கு மிகப்பெரிய அளவில் Robinhood பங்குகளை வாங்கியுள்ளது. பங்கின் விலை 23 சதவீதம் சரிந்ததை அடுத்து இந்த முதலீடு செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
summary: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.
content: Solana wallet Solflare has pledged to cover missed rewards for users after a validator went offline, affecting approximately 1.56 million staked SOL valued at around $160 million. The validator stopped earning rewards due to the outage. However, the wallet provider has not yet publicly disclosed the specific firm responsible for holding the keys to the affected validator.
content_ta: Solana வாலெட் ஆன Solflare, ஒரு வேலிடேட்டர் ஆஃப்லைனில் சென்றதைத் தொடர்ந்து, பயனர்களுக்கு விடுபட்ட ரிவார்டுகளை வழங்குவதாக உறுதியளித்துள்ளது. இதனால் சுமார் $160 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள 1.56 மில்லியன் staked SOL பாதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த செயலிழப்பு காரணமாக வேலிடேட்டர் ரிவார்டுகள் ஈட்டுவதை நிறுத்தியது. இருப்பினும், பாதிக்கப்பட்ட வேலிடேட்டரின் கீகளை வைத்திருந்த குறிப்பிட்ட நிறுவனத்தை வாலெட் நிறுவனம் இன்னும்公开 வெளியிடவில்லை.

title: Bermuda taps WalletConnect to advance its onchain economy plan
summary:
Bermuda's move to onchain payments could set a precedent for national economies, influencing global crypto adoption and financial systems.
The post Bermuda taps WalletConnect to bring crypto payments to PTIX event tickets appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Bermuda has partnered with WalletConnect to integrate crypto payments for PTIX event tickets. This move is part of the territory's broader onchain economy plan and could establish a significant precedent for national financial systems, potentially influencing global cryptocurrency adoption.
content_ta: PTIX நிகழ்வு டிக்கெட்டுகளுக்கு crypto கொடுப்பனவுகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்க WalletConnect உடன் Bermuda கூட்டாண்மை வைத்துள்ளது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை நாட்டின் onchain பொருளாதாரத் திட்டத்தின் ஒரு பகுதியாகும், மேலும் இது தேசிய நிதி அமைப்புகளுக்கு ஒரு முன்னுதாரணமாக அமைவதோடு, உலகளாவிய கிரிப்டோகரன்சி ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளலையும் பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K
summary: BTC price analysis from Glassnode drew attention to $85,000 as the lower boundary of a cost-basis zone for long-term holders.
content: Recent Bitcoin price analysis from Glassnode highlights the $85,000 level as a crucial long-term resistance and cost-basis zone. Analysts point out that movement above this threshold introduces notable selling risks as long-term holders approach key valuation metrics. Market participants are closely monitoring these price levels to gauge potential market trends and trader behavior.
content_ta: Glassnode நடத்திய சமீபத்திய Bitcoin விலை பகுப்பாய்வு, $85,000 அளவை ஒரு முக்கியமான நீண்ட கால எதிர்ப்பு மற்றும் செலவு-அடிப்படை மண்டலமாக எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது. நீண்ட கால வைத்திருப்பவர்கள் முக்கிய மதிப்பீட்டு அளவுகளை நெருங்குவதால், இந்த வரம்பிற்கு மேல் நகர்வது குறிப்பிடத்தக்க விற்பனை அபாயங்களை உருவாக்குகிறது என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர். சாத்தியமான சந்தை போக்குகளை மதிப்பிடுவதற்கு சந்தை பங்கேற்பாளர்கள் இந்த விலை நிலைகளை உன்னிப்பாக கண்காணித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027
summary: Lagarde announced plans to step down as European Central Bank President after serving more than seven years in the role.
content: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde has announced her plans to step down from her position in February 2027. She will leave the role after serving more than seven years as head of the central bank, completing a significant tenure leading the monetary authority.
content_ta: ஐரோப்பிய மத்திய வங்கியின் தலைவர் Christine Lagarde, 2027 பிப்ரவரி மாதம் தனது பதவியிலிருந்து விலகப் போவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளார். மத்திய வங்கியின் தலைவராக ஏழு ஆண்டுகளுக்கும் மேலாகப் பணியாற்றிய பிறகு அவர் தனது பதவிக்காலத்தை நிறைவு செய்ய உள்ளார்.

title: Curve Finance launches on Stellar in first native deployment outside EVM ecosystem
summary: Curve Finance has launched on Stellar mainnet, its first native deployment outside the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) ecosystem.
content: Curve Finance has officially launched on the Stellar mainnet, marking its very first native deployment outside of the Ethereum Virtual Machine ecosystem. This expansion allows the decentralized finance platform to bring its liquidity and exchange features to the Stellar network, broadening its reach beyond traditional EVM-compatible blockchains.
content_ta: Curve Finance தனது முதல் முறையாக EVM சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்புக்கு வெளியே Stellar மெயின்நெட்டில் அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக தொடங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த விரிவாக்கம் டெசென்டிரலைஸ்டு ஃபைனான்ஸ் தளம் அதன் பணப்புழக்கம் மற்றும் பரிமாற்ற அம்சங்களை Stellar நெட்வொர்க்கிற்கு கொண்டு வர அனுமதிக்கிறது.

title: North Korea’s $600 million fake-worker empire has a hidden crypto connection
summary:
The October 28 designations identify Ethereum and Tron addresses, but firms' existing blocking duties extend beyond the listed wallets.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: North Korea is operating a massive fake-worker empire worth hundreds of millions of dollars with significant cryptocurrency connections. Recent government designations have identified specific Ethereum and Tron addresses tied to these illicit activities. Compliance firms and organizations face existing duties to block these networks, requiring them to monitor transactions and address risks that extend well beyond the officially listed wallets.
content_ta: நார்த் கொரியா நூறு மில்லியன் கணக்கான ட மதிப்புள்ள போலி-பணியாளர் சாம்ராஜ்யத்தை நடத்தி வருகிறது, இதில் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி தொடர்புகளும் உள்ளன. சமீபத்திய அரசாங்க அறிவிப்புகள் இந்த சட்டவிரோத செயல்களுடன் தொடர்புடைய குறிப்பிட்ட Ethereum மற்றும் Tron முகவரிகளை அடையாளம் கண்டுள்ளன. இணக்க நிறுவனங்கள் இந்த நெட்வொர்க்குகளைத் தடுக்கும் கடமைகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளன, மேலும் பட்டியலிடப்பட்ட வாலட்டுகளுக்கு அப்பாலும் ஆபத்துக்களைக் கண்காணிக்க வேண்டும்.

title: Bitcoin could reach $1.6 million by 2036, but 82% of the forecast rests on one bet
summary:
About 82% of its modeled valuation comes from gold-and-Bitcoin demand, exposing a sharp divide with JPMorgan’s return assumptions.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: A new forecast suggests Bitcoin could reach $1.6 million by 2036. However, about 82% of this modeled valuation relies heavily on combined gold and Bitcoin demand. This heavy reliance highlights a sharp divide between this forecast and JPMorgan’s return assumptions. Readers can find the full story on CryptoSlate.
content_ta: ஒரு புதிய கணிப்பின்படி, 2036-க்குள் Bitcoin மதிப்பு 1.6 மில்லியன் டாலரை எட்டக்கூடும். எனினும், இதன் மதிப்பில் சுமார் 82% தங்கம் மற்றும் Bitcoin மீதான தேவையையே சார்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த கணிப்பிற்கும் JPMorgan-ன் அனுமானங்களுக்கும் இடையே ஒரு பெரிய கருத்து வேறுபாடு உள்ளதை இது காட்டுகிறது. முழுமையான செய்தியை CryptoSlate-ல் படிக்கலாம்.

title: MEXC Reports 88% Growth in AI-Related Tokenized U.S. Stock and ETF Trading Volume in September, With Four Infrastructure Sectors Up Over 90%
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, October 29, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has released its September TradFi trading data. Tokenized U.S. stock spot trading volume rose 81% month over month, while trading volume for AI-related assets grew 88%. Semiconductor- and memory-related assets accounted for 77% of trading volume among the top 10 Stock and Index Futures, while Pre-IPO Futures trading volume increased 60%. AI Trading Expands Beyond Chips Into Optical Communications and Power, With Four Sectors Each Growing Over 90%   In September, trading volume for AI-related assets within MEXC’s tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs rose 88% month over month, outpacing the 63% growth recorded by non-AI assets. AI-related assets accounted for 48% of tokenized U.S. stock and ETF spot trading volume, up from 44% in August. Trading activity in AI-related assets extended beyond chips to optical communications, power equipment, and data center infrastructure. Trading volume in semiconductors and memory rose 100% month over month, followed by optical communications and networking at 99%, power and energy equipment at 96%, and computing infrastructure and data centers at 91%. All four sectors recorded growth of more than 90%. AI-related companies accounted for six of the top 10 most-traded tokenized U.S. stock and ETFs in September, reaching 59% of the ranking’s combined volume. Crypto-related companies held the remaining four spots, contributing 41%. Assets associated to AI cloud services, chip design, computing infrastructure and data centers together accounted for 38% of the top 10’s combined trading volume, underscoring the concentration of trading activity in AI infrastructure and crypto-related assets. Memory Stocks Lead Futures Trading, With Semiconductor and Memory Assets Accounting for 77% of Top 10 Volume In September, semiconductor- and memory-related assets occupied five of the top 10 spots by MEXC Stock and Index Futures trading volume, contributing 77% of the ranking’s combined volume. Micron (MU), SK hynix, and Sandisk (SNDK) took the top three spots, together accounting for 67% of the top 10’s volume. The Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL) and NVIDIA also ranked among the top 10. Trading activity in Stock and Index Futures remained heavily concentrated in semiconductor and memory assets.   Elsewhere, trading volume for the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) rose 298% month over month, while Bitcoin treasury company Strategy (MSTR) recorded 147% growth. AI hardware stocks also record notable growth: Futures trading volumes for Dell (DELL) and AMD rose 243% and 209%, respectively. AMD’s tokenized spot trading volume also increased 153%, with both Spot and Futures volumes more than doubling. Pre-IPO Futures Trading Volume Rises 60%, Japanese Stock Futures Grow 47% MEXC continued to expand its global stock trading coverage in September. The number of TradFi Futures trading pairson MEXC increased 15% month over month. Pre-IPO and Japanese Stock Futures trading volumes rose 60% and 47%, respectively, making them key areas of growth during the month. MEXC also introduced a dedicated section for Taiwanese stocks, further expanding its coverage of Asian equity markets. Pre-IPO Futures were the fastest-growing TradFi Futures category during the month. Kimi (Moonshot AI) trading volume rose 115% month over month, followed by Enflame at 99% and OpenAI at 51%. September also saw the addition of Pre-IPO Futures for Polymarket, YMTC (Yangtze Memory Technologies), and Oura (Oura Health), extending coverage across prediction markets, semiconductor memory, and wearable technology. From private companies to global equity markets, MEXC is bringing trading opportunities across markets, listing stages, and product formats to a single platform. MEXC currently offers more than 450 Stock and Index Futures trading pairs, over 200 tokenized U.S. stocks, and RealStocks, which provides access to more than 7,000 U.S. stocks and ETFs. Combined with 0-fee trading, this range gives users greater flexibility to access global trading opportunities without being limited to a single market or trading method. MEXC CEO Vugar Usi said, “September’s data shows that demand for AI-related trading is expanding beyond chips into the broader value chain. For trading platforms, the challenge is not simply to expand asset coverage, but to adapt to users’ evolving trading needs. MEXC will remain focused on our users, continuously improving our products and trading experience to reflect emerging market trends, and make new opportunities more accessible.” About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity. MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com Source Risk Disclaimer: This content does not constitute investment advice. Given the volatility of financial markets, including digital assets, tokenized assets, and traditional financial products, investors should carefully assess market conditions, underlying asset fundamentals, and potential financial risks before making any investment or trading decisions.
content: MEXC reported an 88% growth in trading volume for AI-related tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs in September, with four infrastructure sectors growing over 90%. Semiconductor and memory assets dominated futures trading, accounting for 77% of top 10 volume. MEXC also expanded its global market coverage, noting strong growth in Pre-IPO and Japanese stock futures.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் மாதத்தில் AI-தொடர்பான tokenized U.S. stocks மற்றும் ETF வர்த்தக அளவு 88% வளர்ச்சி கண்டுள்ளதாக MEXC தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இதில் நான்கு உள்கட்டமைப்பு துறைகள் 90% க்கும் அதிகமாக வளர்ந்துள்ளன. செமிகண்டக்டர் மற்றும் மெமரி சொத்துக்கள் ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் வர்த்தகத்தில் ஆதிக்கம் செலுத்தின. மேலும், Pre-IPO மற்றும் ஜப்பானிய பங்கு ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ்களிலும் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க வளர்ச்சியை MEXC பதிவு செய்துள்ளது.

Central bank-ல் ஏற்படும் leadership மாற்றங்கள் regulatory சூழலை மாற்றக்கூடினாலும், கடுமையான compliance தேவைகள் ஒரு பெரிய தடையாகவே தொடர்கின்றன.

title: Coast Raises $35 Million to Build the Financial Platform for the Physical Economy
summary:
Coast, the financial platform built for the physical economy, today announced it has raised $35 million in new growth equity funding. The round was led by Thomvest Ventures and joined by new investors Intuit Ventures, Small World Capital, and Alpha Square Group, with participation from existing investors ICONIQ Growth, Accel, Insight Partners, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Avid Ventures, Vintage Investment Partners, Colle Capital, Synchrony, RXR, and The Fintech Fund.
The funding will expand Coast into a broader financial operating system for the physical economy. Coast will use the proceeds to reach more customers and to invest in AI-powered expense automation, new Bill Pay and Accounts Payable products, and embedded partnerships with the fleet and field service platforms its customers already use.
The AI data center boom is pulling construction, HVAC, electrical, utility, and transportation into overdrive. Job postings for HVAC engineers have risen nearly 78% since 2022, and openings for electricians, welders, and construction specialists are up 30%. As these industries grow, their businesses are getting more complex. But the tools they rely on haven't evolved. Most are still forced to piece together generic corporate cards, banking, and fleet tools that weren't designed for how they operate.
Coast is the financial platform built for the physical economy: construction, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, electrical, pest control, solar, transportation, energy, oil and gas, utilities, and more. The company started with America's top-rated fuel card, then expanded into corporate cards, expense management, and bill pay, all designed for how these businesses actually operate.
"The millions of field businesses that keep the physical economy running still lack a financial platform built around the way they work," said Daniel Simon, Founder and CEO of Coast. "Coast is that platform. We're excited to deepen our partnership with Thomvest, who first backed Coast in 2024, and to welcome Intuit Ventures, a deep integration partner that's a critical part of so many of our customers' businesses as they grow."
Coast's industry focus gives customers controls and data that go far beyond a typical corporate card: vehicle- and driver-level visibility, telematics-enabled controls, fuel grade and gallon-level detail, job costing, and payments for trade-specific workflows and fuel, field, supplies, and office needs. That depth extends to accounting, with integrations that automate reconciliation and coding for finance teams. Taken together, the Coast platform saves a customer tens of thousands of dollars and weeks of work that could instead be spent growing their business.
"The physical economy has been underserved by financial software for decades, and Coast is changing that with a platform that brings payments and credit controls into the workflows that businesses already use," said Don Butler, Managing Director at Thomvest Ventures. "We believe that software that acts as a control plane for payments and credit, embedded in the workflows of vertical industries, is one of the most important shifts happening in financial services. Coast is a clear leader on both fronts."
Coast steers drivers to the fueling and purchase options that are most efficient for the company, with approvals and reconciliation running automatically through the systems each customer already relies on. New Bill Pay and Accounts Payable products bring vendor invoices onto the same platform as card spend, giving customers one view of all outgoing money and marking the first step toward a full financial services suite for physical economy businesses. Through partnerships with telematics, fleet management, and field service providers like Samsara and Fleetio, operators can use vehicle location, driver identity, and odometer data to catch an off-route fuel purchase or shut off a card without leaving the software they use to run the fleet.

title: Hyphenate Raises $45M Series A Following 86x Revenue Growth as CFOs Move to Autonomous Finance
summary:
The first wave of finance AI helped teams work faster. The next is taking responsibility for the work itself. Hyphenate, the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO, today announced a $45 million Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners, with participation from B Capital and existing investors including Foundation Capital, BoldCap and Gaia Ventures.
Inside Hyphenate customers, agents are already reconciling cash, processing sales orders, running invoicing, maintaining subledgers and moving the close forward, with finance teams stepping in only where judgment changes the outcome. The round, which brings total funding to $54 million, comes less than a month after Maximor rebranded to Hyphenate, as customers expand its use across the office of the CFO. The company will use the capital to take its agents deeper across the finance function and into strategic finance.
“Every finance team carries a long list of work it does because somebody has to,” said Ramnandan Krishnamurthy, co-founder and CEO of Hyphenate. “Our customers are watching that list shrink in production. Once a team sees the system handle one workflow to an auditor’s standard, they hand it the next one. That is the pattern this company is built around, and this round lets us run it across the whole function.”
12 months from seed to 86x
Hyphenate raised a $9 million seed one year ago to take repetitive work off finance teams. Since then, the company has passed multi-million-dollar ARR, its agents have taken on work across hundreds of entities, thousands of bank accounts and millions of transactions every day, and customers report 90% less repetitive finance work and 75% fewer audit exceptions. The more telling number is what customers do next: 40% expand within their first year, several by two to three times, and the average customer runs six modules.Companies are handing the system larger parts of finance once it has proved itself in one workflow.
What that looks like in production
The expansion is now visible in production, at companies where finance errors carry real cost.
Mini Melts USA, the consumer goods company, runs Hyphenate agents on top of its SAP environment for orders, invoicing and refunds. Within three months of going live, the company was getting back 16,640 hours of finance work a year.
HiBid, one of the largest online auction platforms in North America, has run more than $2.5 billion in GMV through full order-to-cash automation on Hyphenate. Invoicing, collections and cash application across that volume now run as a single continuous process, and the company has cut its month-end close from three weeks to one day.
Groupon, the Nasdaq-listed marketplace, is replacing legacy and home-grown systems with Hyphenate across treasury, order-to-cash and more than a dozen subledger processes.
“As a public company, we run finance at a scale where every number has to stand up to scrutiny: millions of transactions, multiple currencies and markets, and auditors who need the evidence behind all of it. We’re replacing legacy and home-grown tools with Hyphenate because it’s built for that bar, and we see it becoming the AI foundation for our entire finance organization,” said Rana Kashyap, CFO of Groupon.
Synthesia, the AI video platform, is rolling Hyphenate out across its finance function.
“As an AI company, we expect our own operations to run on AI. The breadth of the Hyphenate platform has improved every functional area of our accounting and finance operations. We replaced point solutions with an autonomous finance platform that understands our business. Now the team focuses on exceptions and analysis, which helps make decisions faster,” said Daniel Kim, CFO of Synthesia.
How Hyphenate works
Hyphenate sits on top of the ERP, banks and other systems a company already runs and connects them into a single shared finance context. The business keeps its systems of record and gains a layer that can act across all of it.
On that layer, agents work across five areas of finance: order-to-cash, treasury, GL accounting, procure-to-pay, and reporting and insights. In practice that covers revenue recognition, invoicing, collections, cash reconciliation, accruals, subledgers, AP, close and board reporting.
What sets the system apart is that it’s self learning. Instead of relying on forward-deployed engineers to build bespoke agents for each customer, Hyphenate trains on a company’s historical spreadsheets, emails and system logs, then replays past months to pick up the edge cases traditional software never handled: the tribal knowledge that has kept finance manual. From there, it gets better the longer it runs. An exception resolved during one close becomes precedent for the next. A policy decision made once is applied every time the same situation appears. Every action carries its evidence with it, so the output is audit-ready by default. Month by month, the share of routine work handled autonomously rises, and the finance leader’s involvement narrows to the decisions that require judgment.
The trust threshold is moving
Finance has been one of the hardest functions for AI to enter autonomously. Research commissioned by the company earlier this year found that 96% of CFOs saw freeing teams for strategic work as AI’s biggest benefit, while only 14% completely trusted AI to produce accurate accounting data independently. Ninety-seven percent said human oversight was critical.
Hyphenate’s growth suggests a path through that tension. Autonomy does not require giving an AI system unrestricted control. It requires giving it responsibility within clear boundaries, preserving evidence behind every action and involving a human at the moments where judgment changes the outcome.
“What makes Hyphenate compelling is that autonomy is already showing up in customer operations,” said Abhishek Sharma, Managing Director at Nexus Venture Partners. “Finance has an unusually high bar for accuracy, controls and auditability. Hyphenate has built around that bar from the beginning, and the expansion we are seeing inside customers shows what becomes possible once the system earns the right to take on more work.”

title: Wealthsimple Raises $425 Million at $13.8 Billion Valuation to Accelerate Growth
summary:
Wealthsimple, Canada’s leading financial innovator, announced that it has agreed to an equity round of up to CAD $425 million at a post-money valuation of CAD $13.8 billion. The round includes both a $300 million primary offering and a secondary of up to $125 million. GIC, which co-led Wealthsimple’s 2025 equity round, is leading this round, with participation from existing investors Power Corporation of Canada, IGM Financial Inc., ICONIQ, Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments), and Inovia.
“This raise reflects the deep conviction our partners have in Wealthsimple’s mission and in our role as the company defining the future of financial services in Canada,” said Michael Katchen, CEO and co-founder, Wealthsimple. “These investors know our business deeply and chose to increase their commitment. With their support, we will keep building and innovating until every Canadian can live their entire financial life on Wealthsimple.”
The new capital will help fund Wealthsimple's next phase of growth. The company plans to accelerate its product roadmap, which includes expanding its business, everyday spending and chequing, trading and investment products. The round also includes a secondary offering, which gives employees the opportunity to share in the value they’ve helped create.
“Since co-leading last year’s round, our conviction in Wealthsimple’s ability to become Canada’s leading financial services platform has only grown,” said Vinay Yarlagadda, Managing Director of the Technology Investment Group at GIC. “Through a customer obsessed approach, Wealthsimple has earned deep trust by building products people love and making their financial lives simpler. The team complements that customer focus with an uncommon pace of product innovation, qualities we see in exceptional companies globally. We are excited to lead this financing and support the company as it helps more Canadians build a stronger financial future.”
Wealthsimple announced a CAD $750 million fundraise at a CAD $10 billion valuation in October 2025. Since then, the company’s core investing business has kept growing at a strong pace, while newer chequing, spending and business products are seeing strong adoption. Wealthsimple had its best-ever RRSP season in Q1 2026, with the most account transfers in its history, and in Q2 2026, new chequing account openings outpaced new investment accounts for the first time. In the past year, Wealthsimple has launched more than 50 new products across investing, spending, chequing, and business, including:
Commission-free options trading, futures trading, and IPO Access, which gives Canadians the opportunity to invest in select IPOs at the offering price
Kids and Teens accounts, plus access to QESI grants for Quebec families through their Wealthsimple RESP
Cash deposits at more than 5,300 Canada Post locations, plus free cheque and same-day bank draft delivery
A Portfolio Line of Credit for individuals and businesses that lets clients borrow against their investments
A business chequing account and a prepaid Business Visa card with 1% cash back
“Wealthsimple has grown from an investing app into a platform many Canadians can now rely on for their everyday financial lives,” said Yoonkee Sull, General Partner, ICONIQ. “We believe this shift reflects a team that designs its products with care and listens closely to its clients. We’re proud to continue our partnership with Michael and the team as they build what comes next.”
Key stats as of September 30, 2026:
$169.2 billion in assets under administration, up from $100 billion at the time of the October 2025 raise
More than 4 million Canadians use Wealthsimple
1 in 4 Canadians aged 18 to 40, and 1 in 9 Canadians aged 41 to 55, use Wealthsimple
More than 30,000 businesses use Wealthsimple

title: American Express Card Payments Now Accepted Through TBC Channels in Georgia
summary:
American Express and TBC Georgia, one of the country’s leading financial institutions and part of London-listed TBC Bank Group, have announced an agreement under which TBC will be able to accept American Express Card payments both at merchant locations and online.

Our collaboration with TBC aims to further grow American Express Card acceptance in Georgia and marks another important step in providing our Card Members with more payment choice and creating new opportunities for merchants across the country.”

title: Mollie Enables 60+ Operational Financial Workflows in Everyday AI Tools
summary:
Mollie now enables businesses to manage their daily financial operations directly from their preferred AI assistants Claude and ChatGPT. The European financial services provider today launched official AI plugins an upgraded open Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, allowing companies to execute more than 60 business operations, from creating checkout links and managing subscriptions, through natural conversation, backed by bank-grade security and transparent human oversight.
The launch marks a significant shift in how companies interact with financial software. Instead of navigating separate menus for routine administrative tasks, operators and finance teams can now execute end-to-end workflows directly within the conversational tools they already use every day.
Ready in 60 seconds with clear permissions
Connecting Mollie to an AI workspace requires zero technical configuration, code, or manual API handling:
Standard Authorisation: Users connect securely via an intuitive OAuth authorisation screen supported across major AI assistant directories and platforms.
Transparent Access Scopes: Operators can view and manage exactly what capabilities their AI assistant can prepare, keeping administrative boundaries clear.
Instant Activation: Setup takes less than a minute, allowing non-technical teams to automate recurring workflows immediately without IT overhead.
Breadth in action: 60+ operations across daily business
Moving beyond simple reporting or text summaries, the integration gives AI assistants the ability to prepare concrete, multi-step actions across Mollie’s infrastructure:
Payment Links & Checkouts:

Subscription Management:

Draft Invoicing:

Real-Time Financial Intelligence:


You stay in control. Bank-grade security with human sign-off

title: Broadridge Extends Its CQG Multi-Asset Offering With Kalshi
summary:
Broadridge, a global Fintech leader, today announced that Kalshi event contracts are now available for trading through the front ends and APIs of CQG, a Broadridge Company, a leading provider of futures and options trading, execution management, and market connectivity. Kalshi event contracts will also be available to participants on the NYFIX network through the CQG-NYFIX integration. This new integration brings prediction markets directly into established trading workflows, giving retail and institutional investors a new way to trade on real-world events and manage exposure across asset classes.
 
“Investors want to turn their views on real-world events into actionable trading strategies,” said Ryan Moroney, CEO of CQG. “With Kalshi live on CQG, we’re bringing that opportunity to a platform our clients already trust, alongside the markets they already trade. It’s a powerful next step in Broadridge’s multi-asset strategy, giving investors more choices and brokers a trusted way to meet demand for prediction markets.”
 
As prediction markets attract growing attention from investors and policymakers, the integration pairs Kalshi’s event contract marketplace with CQG’s trading, risk management and portfolio monitoring tools. Brokers and futures commission merchants (FCMs) can offer clients direct trading access and market data, while traders can incorporate event contracts into broader portfolio and hedging strategies within a single platform.
 

"Prediction markets are now part of investors’ trading toolkits, not separate from them,” said Andy Ross, Head of Institutional at Kalshi. “Working with Broadridge and CQG brings Kalshi to a broader audience, connecting event contracts with traditional markets. Traders can now precisely hedge their exposure, not by using some proxy, while trading and monitoring positions in the same environment they already use.”
 
Bringing Prediction Markets into Established Trading Workflows
 
The integration offers direct trading access and market data through CQG front-ends and APIs, broadening distribution of Kalshi markets to FCMs and brokers seeking access through an established trading platform. Additionally, trading access will be made available to over 1,700 buy-side clients who rely on the NYFIX network for their connectivity. Rather than treating prediction markets as a separate trading activity, investors can use their existing infrastructure and tools to monitor event contract positions within their wider trading portfolios and evaluate hedging opportunities across markets.
 
The launch expands Broadridge’s multi-asset trading offering while extending Kalshi’s reach among users of CQG technology. It responds to client demand in the United States and EMEA, with access subject to applicable eligibility and jurisdictional requirements.

title: Airtm and BVNK Partner to Expand Wallet-Native Payments to Emerging Markets
summary:
Airtm, the trusted last-mile financial network for the Global South, and stablecoin infrastructure provider BVNK, a Mastercard company, today announced a partnership that brings wallet-native payments to emerging markets.
The announcement, made today at the Stellar Meridian Conference, comes as Airtm launches Airtm Connect, which allows digital asset companies around the world, including BVNK, to build wallet connections with Airtm's global user base. Through the integration, Airtm users will be able to use funds held in their wallets to pay participating retailers enabled by BVNK, while also creating new ways to fund and receive money.
A Wallet-Native Approach to Global Commerce
The partnership unites two distinct capabilities: Airtm's deep roots in emerging markets and trusted position as a last-mile network, and BVNK's proven stablecoin payment infrastructure and on-ramp connectivity across global banking corridors.
And with BVNK now part of Mastercard, Airtm will also have access to the recently launched Mastercard Global Money Platform, a full-stack, modular infrastructure layer for fiat and stablecoin accounts, payments and money movement, while retaining the customer relationship and avoiding the complexity of integrating multiple providers.
The integration will leverage the Stellar blockchain, a high speed, low-cost payment rail which was recently added to the BVNK platform.
"We believe payments should move natively on-chain - it’s simply a better way to move money. But origination is only half the story. For stablecoin payments to truly work, origination and destination need to be tightly connected. That’s why we’re excited to partner with BVNK," said Rubén Galindo Steckel, CEO of Airtm. "BVNK has solved one of the hardest problems in fintech: reliable, compliant on-ramping at scale. At Airtm, we’ve spent the last decade building the destination layer for the global dollar economy. Together, we're closing the loop. The magic happens when users can fund it reliably and use it more easily in the real-world. That's what this partnership delivers. We're not just adding another integration. We're building the complete on-ramp-to-commerce flow that emerging market users have needed for years."
"We're excited to power Airtm's vision of wallet-native commerce," said Kimberly Mescal Julien, Global Head of Partnerships at BVNK. "Airtm Connect shows what's possible when fintech platforms stop thinking about wallets as silos and start treating them as distribution channels for real-world commerce. We're honored to be the infrastructure backbone."
Expanding Financial Infrastructure Options
BVNK's stablecoin payment capabilities add optionality to Airtm's existing financial infrastructure partners, allowing Airtm to serve customers across diverse funding paths and geographies. This flexibility is critical for a network that operates across multiple jurisdictions in the Global South, including markets where stablecoins are increasingly used as a payment and store of value option, and where regulatory certainty varies and liquidity corridors are fragmented.
"Our infrastructure strategy has always been about choice for Airtm and for our users," said Rubén Galindo Steckel, CEO of Airtm. "We're not betting on a single provider or payment rail. We're building a truly distributed last-mile network. BVNK strengthens that."

title: Ecommpay Launches Savi – the AI Payments Expert for 24/7 Small Business Support

title: Noewe Accounting Raises Half a Million Euros to Transform the Traditional Accounting Services Model
summary:
The company was valued at €2.5 million in this investment round. The funding will support the development of an accounting service powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and automation, enabling small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to access structured financial data, CFO-level insights and tax recommendations on demand.
“I believe in the accounting model being developed by Noewe Accounting, where technology and professional expertise enable businesses to quickly obtain the financial and tax insights they need to make decisions. I see significant potential for this model in Lithuania and other European Union markets. I am committed to contributing to the project’s success not only through investment but also by actively participating in the development of technological solutions and commercial expansion. Together with the team, we aim to create a service that companies will regard as an essential tool for day-to-day business management,” says Philip Van Goethem, an investor based in Lithuania.
“We greatly appreciate Philip’s confidence in our team and the business we are building. An experienced investor’s decision to invest and actively contribute to the project is an important confirmation that we are on the right track and that the next-generation accounting services model we are developing has significant potential. Business leaders need to know what is happening in their businesses now. Information received a month later may explain past performance, but by then it is often too late to take action. That is why we are building Noewe Accounting to ensure clients receive structured financial data and the financial and tax insights derived from it in a timely manner, helping them make concrete business decisions,” says Gediminas Laucius, Managing Partner at Noewe
Technology Shortens the Journey from Transaction to Decision
The model being developed by Noewe Accounting addresses a familiar business problem: financial information often reaches decision-makers too late. At traditional accounting firms, where much of the work is performed manually, processing invoices and transactions, posting entries to the general ledger and preparing financial statements can take weeks. The data needed to make informed decisions may only become available a month later or even further down the line.
Automated data collection and processing, combined with AI solutions, will enable Noewe Accounting to significantly reduce the time between a business transaction taking place and its appearance in accounting records and management reports. Clients will no longer have to wait several weeks for large volumes of invoices and transactions to be processed. The funds raised will be allocated to developing technological solutions and refining the service model, laying the groundwork for further expansion in Lithuania and other EU markets.
Noewe Accounting will be responsible for selecting and implementing the technological solutions. Working together with each client, the company will assess how data flows through their operations, where work is being duplicated and which processes can be automated. This will improve the efficiency of the entire data-processing chain, on which the speed and quality of information depend.
CFO-Level and Analytical Expertise for Smaller Businesses
Faster data processing also transforms the nature of the accounting service itself. With less time spent on data entry and repetitive tasks, specialists will be able to analyse more deeply what drives a client’s profitability, where costs are rising, how cash flows are changing and what actions should be considered.
Small and medium-sized enterprises using Noewe Accounting’s services will be able to access high-level financial analysis, insights and advice that have traditionally been available mainly to larger companies with their own chief financial officers (CFOs) and financial analysis teams. Financial data will be complemented by assessments of the factors driving business performance, forecasts and specific recommendations for management.
“Clients need to understand why their margins are declining, when they might face a shortage of working capital or how a planned investment will affect their cash flow. Technology will enable us to prepare the data needed for analysis quickly, while our specialists will help assess the situation and possible courses of action. Clients will be able to access this expertise as needed, without having to establish a separate financial analysis department,” says Monika Šmigelskaitė, Head of Noewe Accounting.
Tax Monitoring and Advisory as Part of the Service
“Accounting data can reveal tax opportunities a company has yet to take advantage of, as well as areas where its operations present the greatest risks. Our goal is to turn this data into timely, actionable recommendations: which tax relief measures a company could use, which risks it should manage and how and how to optimise its tax position appropriately in light of its business activities and investment plans. These insights will become an ongoing part of the accounting service, helping business leaders make well-informed decisions,” says Sandra Pavlova, Partner at Noewe, heading the Corporate Tax Services practice.
The model draws on the accounting, tax, legal and strategic management expertise available across the Noewe Group. Automated financial analysis and tax assessments will help identify opportunities and risks in a timely manner and evaluate how potential decisions could affect profitability, cash flow and tax liabilities. When clients need to claim tax relief, implement recommended measures or take legal action, tax and legal specialists will provide support. This will enable clients to receive assistance throughout the entire process, from data-driven insights to the practical implementation of decisions.
“Small and medium-sized enterprises face complex financial and tax issues, yet maintaining an in-house team of specialists across all these fields is often too expensive. A technology-driven model allows us to make this expertise available as part of an everyday service. This is where we see the opportunity to fundamentally transform what businesses can expect from their accounting partner,” says G. Laucius.

title: Icon Solutions Appoints Raquel Guillot as Southern Europe Sales Director to Drive Global Adoption of the Icon Payments Framework
summary:
Icon Solutions – the UK fintech enabling banks globally to design and implement state-of-the-art payment systems – has appointed Raquel Guillot as Southern Europe Sales Director, to drive adoption of the Icon Payments Framework (IPF) across the region.
Guillot brings around 20 years of experience spanning banking, analytics, fraud prevention, payments and core banking technology. She began her career at Citibank before moving into financial technology, holding roles at SAS, ACI Worldwide and other technology providers, including Thought Machine.
IPF is the internationally proven payments development framework trusted by banks across the globe, including Citi, UBS, NatWest and BNP Paribas. It enables banks to transform their systems in an accelerated, structured and low-risk way, all on their own terms.
Based in Madrid, Guillot will focus on expanding adoption of IPF among Tier 1 financial institutions across Southern Europe and Latin America, allowing them to deploy payment processing solutions much faster – while staying in total control of timelines and costs.
Commenting on her appointment Raquel Guillot, said: “What attracted me to Icon was the combination of strong technology, a clear understanding of banks’ needs and a team that genuinely cares about its customers. Payments are evolving rapidly, and banks are increasingly recognising the need to modernise their infrastructure to remain competitive and deliver the experiences their customers expect. By consolidating fragmented systems and progressively moving towards a unified infrastructure that supports any payment, anytime, anywhere, banks can realise the foundational objectives of transformation – how to make more with less.”
Liam Jeffs, Global Sales Director at Icon Solutions, commented: “Raquel’s role will be to help banks in this region understand how they can take greater control of their payment strategy, find the right path forward for their business and build the foundations for long-term growth and innovation. Raquel has the right experience to help them do just that – we are delighted to have her on board helping us with our continued expansion.”

content: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis has successfully traced cryptocurrency cash-outs linked to North Korea through the Garantex platform. content_ta: North Korea-ன் கிரிப்டோ பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை Garantex தளம் மூலம் blockchain பகுப்பாய்வு நிறுவனமான Chainalysis கண்டறிந்துள்ளது. North Korea-வின் ஆயுதத் திட்டங்களுக்கு நிதி வழங்கும் IT worker schemes-க்கு உதவியதாக குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டவர்கள் மீது United States புதிய பொருளாதாரத் தடைகளை விதித்ததை அடுத்து இந்த விசாரணை நடத்தப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Unlimit founder backs Phase blockchain with $45M as mainnet launches
summary: Phase’s new network lets smartphone owners earn tokens for validating transactions and sharing internet connections with AI agents.
content: The founder of Unlimit has provided $45 million in backing for the Phase blockchain as its mainnet officially launches. The new network allows smartphone users to earn tokens by validating transactions and sharing their internet connections with artificial intelligence agents, expanding mobile participation in decentralized networks.
content_ta: Unlimit நிறுவனத்தின் நிறுவனர் Phase பிளாக்செயின் (blockchain) திட்டத்திற்கு 45 மில்லியன் டாலர் நிதியுதவி அளித்துள்ளார். அதே நேரத்தில் அதன் மெயின்நெட் (mainnet) அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாகத் தொடங்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய நெட்வொர்க் மூலம் ஸ்மார்ட்போன் பயனர்கள் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை சரிபார்ப்பதன் மூலமும், AI ஏஜெண்டுகளுடன் தங்கள் இணைய இணைப்புகளைப் பகிர்வதன் மூலமும் டோக்கன்களை (tokens) சம்பாதிக்கலாம்.

title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
summary: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.
content: Polygon has expanded its stablecoin payments infrastructure to Solana. This integration allows Solana businesses to access bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers, and global payouts through a single connection. Cross-border firm Kira is among the early adopters of this newly extended payment infrastructure.
content_ta: Polygon நிறுவனம் தனது stablecoin கட்டமைப்பு வசதியை Solana பிளாக்செயின் நெட்வொர்க்கிற்கும் விரிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு மூலம் Solana நிறுவனங்கள் வங்கி நிதி, எம்படெட் வாலட்கள், கிராஸ்-செயின் பரிமாற்றங்கள் மற்றும் உலகளாவிய பேஅவுட்கள் போன்றவற்றை ஒரே இணைப்பின் மூலம் பெற முடியும். சர்வதேச வர்த்தக நிறுவனமான Kira இந்த புதிய கட்டமைப்பை முதன்முதலில் பயன்படுத்துபவர்களில் ஒன்றாகும்.

title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog

Bitcoin Magazine

content: Crypto exchange HTX, associated with Justin Sun, has agreed to leave the UK following a settlement with the Financial Conduct Authority. The confidential agreement resolves the regulator's first crypto marketing enforcement case. Meanwhile, existing sanctions from both the UK and the European Union against related entities remain fully in place.

title: Morning Minute: Hedge Funds Left the BTC ETF Trade and Sovereign Wealth Stepped In
summary: Now the BTC ETFs have flipped green for the month after $400M+ inflows this week, setting the stage for a big November.
content: Recent market data reveals that hedge funds have exited the BTC ETF trade, while sovereign wealth funds have stepped in to take their place. Following strong inflows exceeding $400 million this week, BTC ETFs have turned green for the month. This shift in institutional participation has set a positive stage heading into November.
content_ta: சமீபத்திய சந்தை தரவுகளின்படி, ஹெஜ் ஃபண்டுகள் BTC ETF வர்த்தகத்திலிருந்து வெளியேறியுள்ளன, அதே நேரத்தில் இறையாமை செல்வ நிதி அமைப்புகள் (sovereign wealth funds) அந்த இடத்திற்கு வந்துள்ளன. இந்த வாரம் $400 மில்லியனுக்கும் அதிகமான முதலீடுகள் வந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து, BTC ETFகள் இந்த மாதத்தில் லாபகரமான நிலைக்குத் திரும்பியுள்ளன. நிறுவன முதலீட்டாளர்களின் இந்த மாற்றம் நவம்பர் மாதத்திற்கான சாதகமான சூழலை உருவாக்கியுள்ளது.

content_ta: Uniswap Labs நிறுவனம் TJAR என்ற புதிய கருவியை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் அதன் Token Jar கட்டண மாற்ற அமைப்பு வெளிப்புற செயலிகளுக்கும் கிடைக்கச் செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த வெளியீடு Robinhood உடன் தொடங்குகிறது, இது இந்த அம்சத்தை ஒருங்கிணைக்க அந்த தளத்தை அனுமதிக்கிறது. இந்த வளர்ச்சியானது Uniswap-ன் கட்டண மாற்ற தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் பயன்பாட்டை அதன் சொந்த இடைமுகத்திற்கு அப்பால் விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது.

title: Quantum Says 30,000 Qubits Could Break a Bitcoin Key in an Hour
summary: The estimate assumes cat qubits that go about a century without a bit-flip, while Alice & Bob's largest demonstrator runs on a 12-qubit chip.
content: Quantum computing research suggests that 30,000 qubits could potentially break a Bitcoin key within a single hour. This estimate is based on the use of cat qubits capable of operating for about a century without a bit-flip. Meanwhile, current technology remains far smaller, as demonstrated by Alice & Bob's largest working system running on just a 12-qubit chip.
content_ta: குவாண்டம் கம்ப்யூட்டிங் ஆராய்ச்சியின்படி, 30,000 குபிட்கள் மூலம் வெறும் ஒரு மணி நேரத்திற்குள் ஒரு Bitcoin கீ-யை உடைக்க முடியும் என்று கூறப்பட்டுள்ளது. பிட்-ஃப்ளிப் இல்லாமல் கிட்டத்தட்ட ஒரு நூற்றாண்டு காலம் இயங்கக்கூடிய cat குபிட்களை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டே இந்த மதிப்பீடு கணக்கிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், Alice & Bob நிறுவனத்தின் தற்போதைய மிகப்பெரிய சாதனம் வெறும் 12 குபிட் சிப்பைக் கொண்டதாகவே இயங்குகிறது.
